plan.title: Scholarship Applicant Overview
plan.subtitle: Analyze approval status, academic performance, and regional distribution

panels.title: Average Marks
panels.sql: SELECT AVG("Marks %") AS avg_marks FROM "scholarship_applicants" WHERE "Marks %" IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Approved Count
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM "scholarship_applicants" WHERE "Status" = 'Approved'

panels.title: Pending Count
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM "scholarship_applicants" WHERE "Status" = 'Pending'

panels.title: Status Distribution
panels.sql: SELECT "Status", COUNT(*) AS count FROM "scholarship_applicants" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Marks by Category
panels.sql: SELECT "Category", AVG("Marks %") AS avg_marks FROM "scholarship_applicants" WHERE "Marks %" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Applicants by Taluka
panels.sql: SELECT "Taluka", COUNT(*) AS applicants FROM "scholarship_applicants" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Applicants by District
panels.sql: SELECT "District", COUNT(*) AS applicants FROM "scholarship_applicants" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Top 10 by Marks
panels.sql: SELECT "Naam", "School", "Marks %" FROM "scholarship_applicants" WHERE "Marks %" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "Marks %" DESC LIMIT 10

plan.narrative:
This dashboard provides a comprehensive view of the scholarship applicant pool, highlighting key metrics such as total volume, average academic performance, and approval rates. The top section aggregates the total number of applicants, the mean marks percentage, and the specific counts for approved and pending cases to give an immediate snapshot of the program's current state.

The middle section breaks down the data by categorical variables to identify trends. You can observe the distribution of applicants across different statuses to see where bottlenecks might exist, and compare average marks across various categories like General, OBC, and SC/ST to ensure equitable academic outcomes. Additionally, the regional analysis visualizes the concentration of applicants by Taluka and District, revealing which areas have the highest participation.

Finally, the detailed table lists the top 10 applicants based on their marks percentage, providing a quick reference for high-performing candidates. This granular view complements the aggregated charts, allowing stakeholders to drill down into specific records for further review or verification.
